paragraphs.text: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹשׁ לְמַלְכ֖וּת יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה בָּ֣א נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֛ל יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם וַיָּ֥צַר עָלֶֽיהָ׃
paragraphs.translit: bi-šnat šālōš lə-malkūt Yəhōyāqīm melek-Yəhūdāh bāʾ Nəbūkadneʾṣṣar melek-Bābel Yərūšālaim wa-yāṣar ʿālêhā

i18n.en: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּתֵּן֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י בְּיָד֜וֹ אֶת־יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֗ה וּמִקְצָת֙ כְּלֵ֣י בֵית־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיְבִיאֵ֥ם אֶֽרֶץ־שִׁנְעָ֖ר בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהָ֑יו וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִ֣ים הֵבִ֔יא בֵּ֖ית אוֹצַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yittēn ʾădōnāy bə-yādō ʾet-Yəhōyāqīm melek-Yəhūdāh ū-miqṣāt kəlê bêt-hā-ʾĕlōhīm wa-yəbīʾēm ʾereṣ-Šinʿār bêt ʾĕlōhāyw wə-ʾet-ha-kēlīm hēbīʾ bêt ʾōṣar ʾĕlōhāyw

i18n.en: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the vessels of the house of the Elohim; and he brought them to the land of Shinar, to the house of his god, and the vessels he brought into the treasury of his god.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְאַשְׁפְּנַ֖ז רַ֣ב סָרִיסָ֑יו לְהָבִ֞יא מִבְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וּמִזֶּ֥רַע הַמְּלוּכָ֖ה וּמִן־הַֽפַּרְתְּמִֽים׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yōʾmer ha-melek lə-ʾAšpənaz rab sārīsāyw lə-hābīʾ mi-bənê Yiśrāʾēl ū-mi-zeraʿ ha-məlūkāh ū-min-ha-partəmīm

i18n.en: And the king commanded Ashpenaz, the chief of his eunuchs, to bring some of the sons of Israel, both of the royal seed and of the nobles—

paragraphs.text: יְלָדִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵֽין־בָּהֶ֣ם כָּל־מאוּם֩ וְטוֹבֵ֨י מַרְאֶ֜ה וּמַשְׂכִּילִ֣ים בְּכָל־חָכְמָ֗ה וְיֹ֤דְעֵי דַ֙עַת֙ וּמְבִינֵ֣י מַדָּ֔ע וַאֲשֶׁר֙ כֹּ֣חַ בָּהֶ֔ם לַעֲמֹ֖ד בְּהֵיכַ֣ל הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וּֽלְלַמְּדָ֥ם סֵ֖פֶר וּלְשׁ֥וֹן כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
paragraphs.translit: yəlādīm ʾăšer ʾên-bāhem kol-məʾūm wə-ṭōbê marʾeh ū-maśkīlīm bə-kol-ḥokmāh wə-yōdəʿê daʿat ū-məbīnê maddāʿ wa-ʾăšer kōaḥ bāhem la-ʿămōd bə-hêkal ha-melek ū-lə-lammədām sēper ū-ləšōn kaśdīm

i18n.en: youths in whom was no blemish, well-favored in appearance, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding learning, and competent to stand in the king's palace; and to teach them the writing and the tongue of the Chaldeans.

paragraphs.text: וַיְמַן֩ לָהֶ֨ם הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ דְּבַר־י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֗וֹ מִפַּת־בַּ֤ג הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וּמִיֵּ֣ין מִשְׁתָּ֔יו וּֽלְגַדְּלָ֖ם שָׁנִ֣ים שָׁל֑וֹשׁ וּמִ֨קְצָתָ֔ם יַֽעַמְד֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəman lāhem ha-melek dəbar-yōm bə-yōmō mi-pat-bag ha-melek ū-mi-yên mištāyw ū-lə-gaddəlām šānīm šālōš ū-mi-qəṣātām yaʿamdū li-pnê ha-melek

i18n.en: And the king assigned them a daily portion from the king's rations and from the wine he drank, and that they should be reared for three years, after which they should stand before the king.

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֥י בָהֶ֖ם מִבְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה דָּנִיֵּ֣אל חֲנַנְיָ֔ה מִֽישָׁאֵ֖ל וַעֲזַרְיָֽה׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yhī bāhem mi-bənê Yəhūdāh Dāniyyēʾl Ḥănanyāh Mīšāʾēl wa-ʿĂzaryāh

i18n.en: And among them were, of the sons of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּ֧שֶׂם לָהֶ֛ם שַׂ֥ר הַסָּרִיסִ֖ים שֵׁמ֑וֹת וַיָּ֨שֶׂם לְדָֽנִיֵּ֜אל בֵּ֣לְטְשַׁאצַּ֗ר וְלַֽחֲנַנְיָה֙ שַׁדְרַ֔ךְ וּלְמִֽישָׁאֵ֣ל מֵישַׁ֔ךְ וְלַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה עֲבֵ֥ד נְגֽוֹ׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yāśem lāhem śar ha-sārīsīm šēmōt wa-yāśem lə-Dāniyyēʾl Bēlṭəšaʾṣṣar wə-la-Ḥănanyāh Šadrak ū-lə-Mīšāʾēl Mêšak wə-la-ʿĂzaryāh ʿĂbēd Nəgō

i18n.en: And the chief of the eunuchs gave them names: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abed-nego.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם דָּנִיֵּאל֙ עַל־לִבּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־יִתְגָּאַ֛ל בְּפַתְבַּ֥ג הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וּבְיֵ֣ין מִשְׁתָּ֑יו וַיְבַקֵּשׁ֙ מִשַּׂ֣ר הַסָּרִיסִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א יִתְגָּאָֽל׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yāśem Dāniyyēʾl ʿal-libbō ʾăšer lōʾ-yitgāʾal bə-patbag ha-melek ū-bə-yên mištāyw wa-yəbaqqēš mi-śar ha-sārīsīm ʾăšer lōʾ yitgāʾāl

i18n.en: But Daniel resolved in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king's rations or with the wine he drank; and he asked of the chief of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־דָּ֣נִיֵּ֔אל לְחֶ֖סֶד וּֽלְרַחֲמִ֑ים לִפְנֵ֖י שַׂ֥ר הַסָּרִיסִֽים׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yittēn hā-ʾĕlōhīm ʾet-Dāniyyēʾl lə-ḥesed ū-lə-raḥămīm li-pnê śar ha-sārīsīm

i18n.en: And the Elohim granted Daniel favor and compassion before the chief of the eunuchs.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר שַׂ֤ר הַסָּרִיסִים֙ לְדָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל יָרֵ֤א אֲנִי֙ אֶת־אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִנָּ֔ה אֶת־מַאֲכַלְכֶ֖ם וְאֶת־מִשְׁתֵּיכֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֡ר לָמָּה֩ יִרְאֶ֨ה אֶת־פְּנֵיכֶ֜ם זֹֽעֲפִ֗ים מִן־הַיְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כְּגִֽילְכֶ֔ם וְחִיַּבְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־רֹאשִׁ֖י לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yōʾmer śar ha-sārīsīm lə-Dāniyyēʾl yārēʾ ʾănī ʾet-ʾădōnī ha-melek ʾăšer minnāh ʾet-maʾăkalkem wə-ʾet-mištêkem ʾăšer lāmmāh yirʾeh ʾet-pənêkem zōʿăpīm min-ha-yəlādīm ʾăšer kə-gîləkem wə-ḥiyyabtem ʾet-rōʾšī la-melek

i18n.en: And the chief of the eunuchs said to Daniel, "I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and drink; for why should he see your faces gaunter than the youths of your own age? You would endanger my head before the king."

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר דָּנִיֵּ֖אל אֶל־הַמֶּלְצַ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִנָּה֙ שַׂ֣ר הַסָּרִיסִ֔ים עַל־דָּנִיֵּ֣אל חֲנַנְיָ֔ה מִֽישָׁאֵ֖ל וַעֲזַרְיָֽה׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yōʾmer Dāniyyēʾl ʾel-ha-melṣar ʾăšer minnāh śar ha-sārīsīm ʿal-Dāniyyēʾl Ḥănanyāh Mīšāʾēl wa-ʿĂzaryāh

i18n.en: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the chief of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

paragraphs.text: נַס־נָ֥א אֶת־עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ יָמִ֣ים עֲשָׂרָ֑ה וְיִתְּנוּ־לָ֜נוּ מִן־הַזֵּרֹעִ֛ים וְנֹאכְלָ֖ה וּמַ֥יִם וְנִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
paragraphs.translit: nas-nāʾ ʾet-ʿăbādêkā yāmīm ʿăśārāh wə-yittənū-lānū min-ha-zērōʿīm wə-nōʾkəlāh ū-mayim wə-ništeh

i18n.en: "Test your servants, I pray you, for ten days; let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.

paragraphs.text: וְיֵרָא֤וּ לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ מַרְאֵ֔ינוּ וּמַרְאֵה֙ הַיְלָדִ֔ים הָאֹ֣כְלִ֔ים אֵ֖ת פַּתְבַּ֣ג הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְאֵ֔ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה עִם־עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-yērāʾū lə-pānêkā marʾênū ū-marʾēh ha-yəlādīm hā-ʾōkəlīm ʾēt patbag ha-melek wə-ka-ʾăšer tirʾeh ʿăśēh ʿim-ʿăbādêkā

i18n.en: Then let our countenances be examined before you, alongside the countenance of the youths who eat the king's rations; and deal with your servants according to what you see."

paragraphs.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע לָהֶ֖ם לַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַיְנַסֵּ֖ם יָמִ֥ים עֲשָׂרָֽה׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yišmaʿ lāhem la-dābār ha-zeh wa-yənassēm yāmīm ʿăśārāh

i18n.en: So he hearkened to them in this matter and tested them for ten days.

paragraphs.text: וּמִקְצָת֙ יָמִ֣ים עֲשָׂרָ֔ה נִרְאָ֤ה מַרְאֵיהֶם֙ ט֔וֹב וּבְרִיאֵ֖י בָּשָׂ֑ר מִן־כָּל־הַיְלָדִ֔ים הָאֹ֣כְלִ֔ים אֵ֖ת פַּתְבַּ֥ג הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-mi-qəṣāt yāmīm ʿăśārāh nirʾāh marʾêhem ṭōb ū-bərīʾê bāśār min-kol-ha-yəlādīm hā-ʾōkəlīm ʾēt patbag ha-melek

i18n.en: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and their flesh fuller than all the youths who ate the king's rations.

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֣י הַמֶּלְצַ֗ר נֹשֵׂא֙ אֶת־פַּתְבָּגָ֔ם וְיֵ֖ין מִשְׁתֵּיהֶ֑ם וְנֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם זֵרְעֹנִֽים׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yhī ha-melṣar nōśēʾ ʾet-patbāgām wə-yên mištêhem wə-nōtēn lāhem zērəʿōnīm

i18n.en: So the steward took away their rations and the wine they were to drink, and gave them vegetables.

paragraphs.text: וְהַיְלָדִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אַרְבַּעְתָּ֔ם נָתַ֨ן לָהֶ֧ם הָֽאֱלֹהִ֛ים מַדָּ֥ע וְהַשְׂכֵּ֖ל בְּכָל־סֵ֣פֶר וְחָכְמָ֑ה וְדָנִיֵּ֣אל הֵבִ֔ין בְּכָל־חָז֖וֹן וַחֲלֹמֽוֹת׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-ha-yəlādīm hā-ʾēlleh ʾarbaʿtām nātan lāhem hā-ʾĕlōhīm maddāʿ wə-haśkēl bə-kol-sēper wə-ḥokmāh wə-Dāniyyēʾl hēbīn bə-kol-ḥāzōn wa-ḥălōmōt

i18n.en: And as for these four youths, the Elohim gave them knowledge and skill in all writing and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in every vision and dream.

paragraphs.text: וּלְמִקְצָת֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־אָמַ֥ר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לַהֲבִיאָ֑ם וַיְבִיאֵם֙ שַׂ֣ר הַסָּרִיסִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י נְבֻכַדְנֶצַּֽר׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-lə-miqṣāt ha-yāmīm ʾăšer-ʾāmar ha-melek la-hăbīʾām wa-yəbīʾēm śar ha-sārīsīm li-pnê Nəbukadneṣṣar

i18n.en: And at the end of the days which the king had appointed for their presentation, the chief of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

paragraphs.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתָּם֮ הַמֶּלֶךְ֒ וְלֹ֤א נִמְצָא֙ מִכֻּלָּ֔ם כְּדָנִיֵּ֣אל חֲנַנְיָ֔ה מִֽישָׁאֵ֖ל וַעֲזַרְיָ֑ה וַיַּעַמְד֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yədabbēr ʾittām ha-melek wə-lōʾ nimṣāʾ mi-kullām kə-Dāniyyēʾl Ḥănanyāh Mīšāʾēl wa-ʿĂzaryāh wa-yaʿamdū li-pnê ha-melek

i18n.en: And the king spoke with them; and among all of them none was found like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah; so they stood before the king.

paragraphs.text: וְכֹ֗ל דְּבַר֙ חָכְמַ֣ת בִּינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־בִּקֵּ֥שׁ מֵהֶ֖ם הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַֽיִּמְצָאֵ֞ם עֶ֣שֶׂר יָד֗וֹת עַ֤ל כָּל־הַֽחַרְטֻמִּים֙ הָֽאַשָּׁפִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּכָל־מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-kōl dəbar ḥokmat bīnāh ʾăšer-biqqēš mēhem ha-melek wa-yimṣāʾēm ʿeśer yādōt ʿal kol-ha-ḥarṭummīm hā-ʾaššāpīm ʾăšer bə-kol-malkūtō

i18n.en: And in every matter of wisdom and understanding concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters that were in all his realm.

paragraphs.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ דָּֽנִיֵּ֔אל עַד־שְׁנַ֥ת אַחַ֖ת לְכ֥וֹרֶשׁ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-yhī Dāniyyēʾl ʿad-šənat ʾaḥat lə-Kōreš ha-melek

i18n.en: And Daniel continued unto the first year of King Cyrus.
